main.description: The group's website: static files its host serves as they are at the group's address there, `https://<address>/`, each page sandboxed to an origin of its own. Kept in the group's public repo and written by those whose roles carry group.configure; each publish replaces it, and deleting it takes the site down.

files.description: What the site serves, each at a path of its own.

notFound.description: The path of a file in `files` served, with status 404, for a path no file has.

fallback.description: The path of a file in `files` served, with status 200, for a page no file has, as a single-page app routes in the browser: a request asking for `text/html`, or for a path whose last segment has no extension. Taken before `notFound`; anything else missing gets `notFound`.

createdAt.description: When this version of the site was published.

acts.description: The host's procedures the site's pages may ask, as whoever is looking and signed in, each acting for that person alone and checked as the host checks it from anywhere, such as reporting what they see.

reads.description: The host's methods the site's pages may ask, as whoever is looking and signed in, through the page the host serves around them. A site with none, no acts and no writes, is served as its files alone.

writes.description: The records the site's pages may write, as whoever is looking and signed in, in their own repo in the group's spaces, through the page the host serves around them: each asked of the visitor's PDS when they sign in. What a space lets each visitor write is still its access record's to say.

path.description: Where it is served under the site's root: `/`-separated, with no leading `/`, no empty, `.` or `..` segment. `x/index.html` is served at `x/` too.

contentType.description: The `Content-Type` it is served with, such as `text/html; charset=utf-8`; without it, the type its path's extension names.

act.description: One of the host's procedures a site's pages may ask, as the visitor.

method.description: The procedure's NSID, as `knownValues` lists those a site may ask.

read.description: One of the host's methods a site's pages may ask.

method.description: The method's NSID: one of the host's reads, as `knownValues` lists them.

write.description: A kind of record a site's pages may write in the visitor's own repo, in the group's spaces of one type.

space.description: The type of the group's spaces it is written in, such as fyi.opensocial.members.

collection.description: The record's collection, such as fyi.opensocial.acceptance.
